title: DashVMC: Real-Time Discrete World Model Control in Geometry Dash
abstract: arXiv:2609.40003v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World-model agents are usually evaluated in simulators that can wait for the policy; live games impose the opposite constraint, requiring capture, prediction, and action before the next frame. We present DashVMC, which learns a compact, action-conditioned world model from approximately two hours of recorded Geometry Dash gameplay. To test whether the learned dynamics are actionable, a controller is initialized by behavioural cloning (BC) and refined with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) entirely in frozen-model rollouts, without further interaction with the live game. Across three controller seeds, the refined policies survive longer than their BC initializations on all three official levels and a held-out community layout. At deployment, the baseline skips visual generation and sustains a 60-Hz capture-to-action loop on a consumer GPU. translated_title: DashVMC：Geometry Dash中的实时离散世界模型控制
translated_abstract: 世界模型智能体通常是在可以等待策略计算的模拟器中进行评估的；而实时游戏则提出了相反的约束，要求在下一帧到来之前完成画面捕获、预测和动作执行。我们提出了DashVMC，它从约两小时的Geometry Dash游戏录像中学习一个紧凑的、以动作为条件的世界模型。为了检验所学习到的动态是否真正可用于控制，控制器先通过行为克隆（BC）进行初始化，随后使用近端策略优化（PPO）完全在冻结模型的轨迹推演中进行优化，无需与实时游戏进行任何 further 交互。在三个控制器随机种子下，优化后的策略在全部三个官方关卡以及一个留出的社区自制关卡上的存活时间均长于其BC初始版本。在部署时，该基线方法跳过视觉生成环节，在消费级GPU上维持每秒60帧的从画面捕获到动作输出的循环。基于动作条件的续写推演和轨迹诊断表明，该模型在（截断处）……
tldr: DashVMC仅用约两小时Geometry Dash游戏录像学习紧凑的动作条件世界模型，控制器通过BC初始化后完全在冻结模型推演中用PPO优化即可超越初始性能，并在消费级GPU上实现60Hz的实时捕获-动作闭环。
